failure_attribution.primary: The all-available global top-4 operation is a replacement operator, not merely a coverage extension. Omitted views replace legacy retained views even when retained count is unchanged, rotating most primitive prototypes by approximately 8-9 degrees at the median.
failure_attribution.why_existing_gate_missed_it: Coverage and retained-count nonregression cannot detect count-preserving replacement. Scene-average LOO and resultant can improve when newly retained views are mutually coherent but belong to background or a competing identity.
failure_attribution.single_view_resultant_failure: A one-view teacher has directional resultant exactly or nearly one by construction, so resultant without count sufficiency assigns false confidence to most newly covered primitives.
failure_attribution.not_primarily_coverage: The frozen valid-domain score caches already treated every accepted primitive as valid; newly teacher-valid rows replaced prior O0 fallback descriptors but did not expand the KNN validity domain.
failure_attribution.conclusion: The failure is view-admission and prototype-identity drift, not an evaluator, KNN-domain, coverage-count, or thermal issue.

posthoc_query_explanations_not_used_for_.interpretation: The same count-preserving prototype replacement can greatly help one query and destroy another. Therefore query names, score changes, and target masks cannot define the admission rule.

minimal_candidate.name: incremental_effective_evidence_anchored_fusion_v1

formula.legacy_valid_output: normalize(E_L*mu_L+DeltaE*mu_A); if DeltaE=0 this is exactly mu_L
formula.legacy_invalid_output: mu_A only when E_A>0, equivalently n_A>=2; otherwise retain O0 fallback and do not create a teacher
formula.validity: preserve every legacy-valid row; add a previously invalid row only with at least two retained views

properties.all_available_summary_double_counting_av: Only effective evidence beyond the legacy evidence is treated as innovation.
properties.count_preserving_replacement_safeguard: When count is unchanged, a small resultant increase receives only a small innovation weight; a resultant decrease receives zero weight.

minimal_candidate.caveat: This diagnostic shows that the formula targets the observed replacement mechanism; it is not a target-performance claim and must pass the source gate below before any target execution.

required_streaming_capture_per_heldout_s: legacy n_L, r_L, and mu_L excluding the heldout observation
all-available n_A, r_A, and mu_A excluding the heldout observation
candidate prediction from the frozen formula
statistics: per-scene fraction of legacy rows preserved
per-scene newly valid rows split by retained count
pass_conditions: pooled mean cosine strictly improves over legacy
every scene mean cosine is nonregressing
every scene exact p05 cosine is nonregressing
every legacy-valid primitive remains valid by construction
all values are finite and all scene/query parameters are absent
executable_source_gate_design.selection: One candidate versus legacy only; no parameter sweep, no target metric retry, and no aggregate compensation for a regressing scene.
executable_source_gate_design.after_pass: Materialize one frozen all-scene candidate and run each target benchmark at most once under its accepted frozen evaluator.

missing_per_primitive_data: legacy and all-available retained top-view frame IDs
retained view descriptors or an online per-fold legacy/all summary
per-heldout-fold candidate cosine values needed for exact p05
marginal responsibility of retained legacy versus omitted views
missing_scene_evidence: Figurines all-available teacher and source-LOO capture for its 295-view domain
Ramen identity-control receipt showing the 120-view all-available path is bitwise legacy-equivalent
durable_evidence_gaps.robust_m_estimator_status: A view-level anchored median, Huber, or redescending M-estimator cannot be evaluated or reconstructed exactly from final mean/count/resultant alone. It requires the retained per-view descriptors or an online robust accumulator rerun.
durable_evidence_gaps.authorization_consequence: Do not authorize a target metric for the proposed candidate from the present static statistics alone.

decision.next_action: Implement the formula and its all-four-scene streaming source-LOO capture together, then apply the preregistered mean-and-p05 gate.
